text: A shelf of ledgers: forty years of taking in lodgers,
ruled by week, by name and by trade.
The trade column used to say QUARRY all the way down. Now it says FOUNDATION.
The kitchen, laid for a household of two and cooking for five.
A made-up bed in the front room, because the back rooms are all let.
A grey coat is folded over the end of it, brushed, with the badge outward.
A shelf of things lodgers have left behind. Mostly gloves.
One brass instrument nobody has claimed, with a maker's mark
and a serial number, and no idea at all what it measures.
